result_text:
Promotions now carry an optional description, and it comes back in every promotion listing and in the lookup by code. The full suite passes offline (608 tests, including a new one for this).

What changed, all under `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice` unless noted:

- **`src/main/resources/schema.sql`**: new nullable `description VARCHAR(200)` column on `promotion`.
- **`model/Promotion.java`**: `description` is the last record component. It is null when the promotion has none.
- **`service/PromotionService.java`**: the existing 5-argument `createPromotion` is unchanged and delegates to a new 6-argument overload that takes the description. A null or blank description is stored as null, the same way blank categories are handled.
- **`PromotionStore.java`**: the insert writes the description, and the shared `SELECT` includes it. That one select feeds the active-on-date, region, category, best-promotion, unused and by-code queries, so they all return it.
- **`Rows.java`**: the promotion row mapper reads the column.
- **`src/test/.../PromotionTest.java`**: new test `keepsDescriptionOfPromotionAndReturnsItWhenListed`. It covers a stored description, a missing one, a blank one, and the active, category and by-code lookups.

Nothing is committed. I did not add a description to the demo data in `DemoScenario`, so the existing demo promotions still have none.
